lines: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，
充充满满的有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，
and lived among us. We saw his glory
such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father
道成了肉身，住在我们中间，
充充满满的有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，
道成了肉身，住在我們中間，
充充滿滿的有恩典有真理。我們也見過他的榮光，
and lived among us. We saw his glory
such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father
And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory--such glory as is given to an only son by his father--saw it to be true and full of grace.
我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。
我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。
我也認識他們，他們也跟着我。
My sheep give ear to my voice
and I have knowledge of them
我已经给你们权柄可以践踏蛇和蝎子，
又胜过仇敌一切的能力，
I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions
and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
我已经给你们权柄可以践踏蛇和蝎子，
又胜过仇敌一切的能力，
我已經給你們權柄可以踐踏蛇和蠍子，
又勝過仇敵一切的能力，
I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions
and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
I have given you power to put your feet on snakes and evil beasts
and over all the strength of him who is against you: and nothing will do you damage.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
For to everyone who makes a request
it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire; and to him who gives the sign
你摆设筵席，倒要请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，
But when you make a feast
你摆设筵席，倒要请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，
你擺設筵席，倒要請那貧窮的、殘廢的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，
But when you make a feast
But when you give a feast
send for the poor and the blind and those who are broken in body:
有求你的，就给他；有向你借贷的，
Give to him who asks you
and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
有求你的，就给他；有向你借贷的，
有求你的，就給他；有向你借貸的，
Give to him who asks you
and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
Give to him who comes with a request
and keep not your property from him who would for a time make use of it.
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled
and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
Whoever exalts himself will be humbled
and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
And whoever makes himself high will be made low
and whoever makes himself low will be made high.
「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、茴香、芹菜，
献上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，
反倒不行了。这更重的是你们当行的；
and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice
and faith. But you ought to have done these
and not to have left the other undone.
「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、茴香、芹菜，
献上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，
反倒不行了。这更重的是你们当行的；
「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、茴香、芹菜，
獻上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，
反倒不行了。這更重的是你們當行的；
and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice
and faith. But you ought to have done these
and not to have left the other undone.
false ones! for you make men give a tenth of all sorts of sweet-smelling plants
but you give no thought to the more important things of the law
and faith; but it is right for you to do these
and not to let the others be undone.
我赤身露体，你们给我穿；
and you clothed me. I was sick
and you visited me. I was in prison
我赤身露体，你们给我穿；
我赤身露體，你們給我穿；
and you clothed me. I was sick
and you visited me. I was in prison
and you gave it to me: when I was ill
既有人的样子，就自己卑微，
And being found in human form
既有人的样子，就自己卑微，
既有人的樣子，就自己卑微，
And being found in human form
And being seen in form as a man
and let himself be put to death
even the death of the cross.
使智慧人听见，增长学问，
that the wise man may hear
and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
使智慧人听见，增长学问，
使智慧人聽見，增長學問，
that the wise man may hear
and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
and the acts of the man of good sense will be wisely guided:)
搜求他，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
If you seek her as silver
and search for her as for hidden treasures:
搜求他，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
搜求他，如搜求隱藏的珍寶，
If you seek her as silver
and search for her as for hidden treasures:
If you are looking for her as for silver
and searching for her as for stored-up wealth;
Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
Keep a watch on your behaviour; let all your ways be rightly ordered.
The merciful man does good to his own soul
but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
The merciful man does good to his own soul
but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
The man who has mercy will be rewarded
but the cruel man is the cause of trouble to himself.
Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil
but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil
but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
Deceit is in the heart of those whose designs are evil
but for those purposing peace there is joy.
强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
強如多有財寶，煩亂不安。
Better is a little with the fear of the Lord
than great wealth together with trouble.
耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。
Yahweh is far from the wicked
but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。
耶和華遠離惡人，卻聽義人的禱告。
Yahweh is far from the wicked
but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
The Lord is far from sinners
but his ear is open to the prayer of the upright.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes
to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes
to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! and to get knowledge is more to be desired than silver.
不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
不要勞碌求富，休仗自己的聰明。
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
Take no care to get wealth; let there be an end to your desire for money.
The fear of man proves to be a snare
but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
The fear of man proves to be a snare
but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
The fear of man is a cause of danger: but whoever puts his faith in the Lord will have a safe place on high.
